basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and longtime DotA2 enthusiast from Melbourne, Australia. I've been playing DotA since its early days on Warcraft III and enjoy theory-crafting fun and unconventional strategies. When I'm not gaming, I'm a freelance graphic designer with a penchant for minimalist art. I enjoy a good laugh and often spend my evenings browsing Reddit while sipping on a flat white. Currently single and loving the freedom to pursue my passions without any strings attached.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable in multiplayer online battle arenas (MOBAs) primarily through years of gaming and participation in online gaming communities. Self-taught in graphic design, utilizing platforms like Skillshare and YouTube to enhance my skills.
